title: Standard Schema validation adapter
current_support: Custom sync and async validators exist; no exported Standard Schema bridge.
proposed_increment: Accept compatible schemas, execute once per relevant value revision, and map nested issues to live nodes without requiring injection.
priority_rationale: Avoids duplicating domain rules and connects several schema ecosystems through one small public entry point.
observed_precedent: Angular 22 implements a Standard Schema bridge and tests reactive schemas and nested issue paths.
source_titles: Angular 22.1.6: Standard Schema implementation; Angular 22.1.6: Standard Schema tests; TanStack Form: validation
source_notes: Pinned release implementation; sync/async execution and issue targeting.; Pinned tests; reactive schemas, nested paths, mixed validation and empty values.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Changes relative to a saved baseline
current_support: dirty() records interaction and stays dirty after a user restores the original value.
proposed_increment: Add a separate comparison-based changed state for leaves and aggregates, with explicit equality and array-order semantics.
priority_rationale: Supports correct Save buttons and unsaved-change warnings across ordinary edit screens.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form exposes isDirty relative to default values.
source_notes: Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.

title: Redefine the reset baseline after loading or saving
current_support: reset(value) changes values and interaction; resetToInitial() retains declaration-time defaults.
proposed_increment: Provide an explicit operation to accept a new baseline, including partial/subtree policy and array identity handling.
priority_rationale: Makes the saved server record the next meaningful reset target.
observed_precedent: Mantine exposes setInitialValues; Inertia exposes defaults updates.
source_titles: Mantine: form values; Inertia v2: forms
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Versioned v2 reference; newer documentation exists, so this is not a latest-version claim.

title: Refresh server data while preserving local edits
current_support: set(), patch() and trackBy reconciliation exist; callers implement edit-aware merging.
proposed_increment: Merge incoming records against a baseline, preserving edited fields and reporting conflicting edits or row removals.
priority_rationale: Prevents a background refresh from silently overwriting work.
observed_precedent: Final Form documents keepDirtyOnReinitialize; React Hook Form offers keepDirtyValues.
source_titles: Final Form: Config; React Hook Form: reset
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.

title: Typed control-to-model codecs
current_support: Native number/date parsing and CVA error contributions exist; custom conversion is application code.
proposed_increment: Expose reusable parse/format contracts with different control and model types, preserving incomplete input and the last valid committed value.
priority_rationale: Simplifies dates, money and third-party controls without repeating conversion and error lifecycle logic.
observed_precedent: Superforms provides typed value proxies for string-facing inputs.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Validation execution triggers independent of value commits
current_support: Reactive validators and buffered commits exist; debounce changes when values commit.
proposed_increment: Offer explicit change, blur or submit validation scheduling while retaining immediate committed-value updates when requested.
priority_rationale: Reduces expensive work without delaying the model that other application logic reads.
observed_precedent: TanStack Form separates validation by event cause.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Public mutation batching
current_support: Individual aggregate operations batch internally; separate consumer operations still form separate updates.
proposed_increment: Expose a scoped batch for several mutations, with defined callback delivery, validation timing and exception behavior.
priority_rationale: Keeps dependent multi-field changes coherent and avoids repeated application callbacks.
observed_precedent: Final Form exposes batch() and separate validation pause/resume operations.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Nonblocking warnings
current_support: Validation errors participate in invalidity; informational feedback requires separate application state.
proposed_increment: Add a warning channel with its own aggregation and messages that never blocks submission.
priority_rationale: Allows quality advice and suspicious-value hints without misclassifying acceptable data as invalid.
observed_precedent: Felte supports separate warning validators and stores.
source_notes: Svelte documentation; separate warning validation is explicit.

title: Backend error maps addressed by paths
current_support: onSubmit can return node-targeted errors and rejects stale results; applications translate backend paths themselves.
proposed_increment: Translate configurable backend path formats into live node targets, reporting unmatched paths and preserving request/value revision checks.
priority_rationale: Removes recurring glue for nested API validation responses.
observed_precedent: Vuelidate accepts external result maps; VeeValidate accepts field error maps.
source_titles: Vuelidate: advanced usage; VeeValidate v4: handling forms
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Versioned v4 reference; not represented as the newest major.

title: Awaitable validation of a field or subtree
current_support: Consumers read validation signals and configure validators; no public node-level awaitable validation runner is exposed.
proposed_increment: Run or join relevant validation, resolve against a defined value revision, and handle cancellation, detachment and pending descendants.
priority_rationale: Provides a dependable foundation for Next, Check and Save workflows.
observed_precedent: VeeValidate exposes validate() and validateField().
source_notes: Versioned v5 API reference.

title: Shared error visibility policy
current_support: dirty, touched, submitted and errors are available; each component decides when to show messages.
proposed_increment: Provide a reactive visible-errors policy for blur, touch, submission and optional delayed presentation, without altering validity.
priority_rationale: Makes custom controls consistent and avoids premature or flickering feedback.
observed_precedent: FormKit configures validation visibility separately from rule execution.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Development-only node inspector
current_support: Signals and error queries are inspectable manually; no dedicated form inspector ships.
proposed_increment: Inspect tree structure, committed/control values, contributing errors, interaction state and ownership, with values redacted by default.
priority_rationale: Shortens diagnosis of complex forms and makes the library easier to learn.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form ships a DevTools companion.
source_notes: Official companion tool; README/API evidence.

title: First-class wizard controller
current_support: A multi-step cookbook already demonstrates branch rendering, touching and validity checks.
proposed_increment: Package step registration, guarded navigation, pending-validation coordination and routing to the step containing a submission error.
priority_rationale: Turns a repeated recipe into a consistent, testable workflow API.
observed_precedent: FormKit provides step navigation and beforeStepChange guards.
source_notes: Official @formkit/addons plugin; navigation helpers and step guards.

title: Autosave coordinator
current_support: onValueChange can start a save; consumers own queuing, cancellation, retries and saved-state tracking.
proposed_increment: Coordinate debounced saves of committed snapshots, coalesce newer edits, expose outcomes, and accept only the revision actually saved as the baseline.
priority_rationale: Removes a common source of races and misleading saved indicators.
observed_precedent: React Final Form publishes autosave examples.
source_notes: Official recipes; autosave and warnings are examples, not promises about core APIs.

title: Opt-in persistent drafts
current_support: Applications can observe values and use storage; no managed persistence adapter ships.
proposed_increment: Persist selected fields with a key, expiry, serialization policy and restore decision; clear the draft only under an explicit successful-save policy.
priority_rationale: Protects long forms from reloads without requiring each app to build storage lifecycle code.
observed_precedent: FormKit provides a local-storage plugin with persistence hooks and expiry.
source_notes: Official plugin; persisted drafts and lifecycle options.

title: Capture and restore form checkpoints
current_support: reset and resetToInitial exist; they do not capture arbitrary current interaction and structural checkpoints.
proposed_increment: Capture values, supported node structure and interaction state; restore synchronously while cancelling stale pending work and rebuilding derived validation.
priority_rationale: Enables cancelable edits, navigation restoration and reproducible debugging.
observed_precedent: Superforms provides capture/restore snapshots.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Export changed values and structural patches
current_support: Full committed values are available; patch() consumes partial updates but does not produce a diff.
proposed_increment: Produce a typed change summary or explicit add/remove/replace/move representation against a chosen baseline, including array identity policy.
priority_rationale: Makes PATCH requests and review screens accurate when fields or rows disappear.
observed_precedent: Ember Changeset exposes a list of staged changes; structural patch output is our proposed extension.
source_notes: Maintainer repository; staged changes, execution, rollback and snapshots.

title: Accessible error summary with invalid-field navigation
current_support: allErrors and focus() exist; aggregate focus chooses a bound control rather than a dedicated invalid-field navigation strategy.
proposed_increment: Create ordered, labeled summary entries and focus/reveal the corresponding invalid control, including a host hook for hidden pages.
priority_rationale: Helps users recover from large invalid submissions with keyboard and assistive technology.
observed_precedent: Ant Design provides scrollToFirstError; Conform documents accessible error associations.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Cancelable submission with AbortSignal
current_support: submit() exposes submitting state and blocks concurrent calls; no caller-owned cancellation contract is public.
proposed_increment: Pass a request-scoped signal to the submit handler and expose cancellation with defined outcomes and stale-result rejection.
priority_rationale: Supports leaving a screen, replacing an autosave and stopping slow uploads.
observed_precedent: Inertia forms expose cancellation.
source_notes: Versioned v2 reference; newer documentation exists, so this is not a latest-version claim.

title: Async record initialization state
current_support: The edit-server-data recipe loads externally and calls set/reset; loading and request races are application concerns.
proposed_increment: Coordinate loader state, errors, retries and latest-record ownership, then establish the baseline without overwriting intervening edits.
priority_rationale: Removes boilerplate from nearly every server-backed edit form.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form supports async default values and an isLoading state.
source_titles: React Hook Form: useForm; React Hook Form: formState
source_notes: Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.; Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.

title: Typed submission output transformations
current_support: onSubmit receives exposed form values; applications transform them inside their handlers.
proposed_increment: Define a typed input-to-output projection evaluated for a specific submit snapshot, optionally using a schema's parsed output.
priority_rationale: Separates editable representations from the DTO while retaining compile-time output inference.
observed_precedent: Mantine exposes transformValues and its transformed output type.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Submit policy that waits for validation
current_support: The valid gate refuses pending state; it does not await completion and automatically resume the same attempt.
proposed_increment: Add an explicit wait policy using a stable value revision, cancellation and timeout; invoke the handler only after that revision satisfies the gate.
priority_rationale: Prevents users needing a second click after remote validation finishes.
observed_precedent: jQuery Validation defers submission while remote requests are pending.
source_notes: Official source; step validation, deferred submission, and reuse of matching remote-validation results.

title: Public source-owned error contributions
current_support: CVA/state hooks, Angular-control bridges and returned submission errors already contribute errors through scoped paths.
proposed_increment: Expose an application-level error source with update and dispose semantics, preserving independent sources and clearing only the owner's errors.
priority_rationale: Supports external services, imported diagnostics and background checks outside a bound component.
observed_precedent: Vuelidate external results illustrate independent application error input; ownership leases are our proposed refinement.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Typed submit intents
current_support: Native submit events can be observed; submit() has no typed action metadata parameter.
proposed_increment: Pass a typed intent such as saveDraft or publish through native and programmatic submission, with explicitly selected gating policy.
priority_rationale: Lets one form support different actions without side-channel flags or timing-sensitive button handlers.
observed_precedent: TanStack Form supports submit metadata; Conform demonstrates intent buttons.
source_titles: TanStack Form: submission handling; Conform: intent buttons
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Submission outcome and result state
current_support: submitted means an attempt occurred; submitting does not record success, failure, result or attempt count.
proposed_increment: Expose typed last outcome, attempt count and optional result data with reset and stale-attempt semantics.
priority_rationale: Simplifies success feedback, retries and parent coordination.
observed_precedent: Final Form exposes success/failure state; React Hook Form exposes submission count and success.
source_titles: Final Form: FormState; React Hook Form: formState
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.

title: Unsaved-change navigation guard
current_support: Consumers can combine router hooks and state; dirty alone cannot represent data restored to its saved value.
proposed_increment: Provide router and beforeunload integration driven by baseline changes, with explicit discard/continue handling and disposal.
priority_rationale: Prevents accidental abandonment while avoiding warnings for already-saved or reverted data.
observed_precedent: Superforms supports tainted-form navigation confirmation.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Selective reset options
current_support: reset clears interaction in its scope; resetToInitial restores captured defaults; retention is not configurable.
proposed_increment: Allow explicit retention of selected interaction, error-source and submission states while independently choosing values and baseline policy.
priority_rationale: Supports successful partial saves and server corrections without resetting unrelated UX.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form exposes granular reset retention options.
source_notes: Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.

title: Server validation hydration envelope
current_support: Angular binding hydration is tested; values and errors can be supplied separately, but no portable server form-state envelope exists.
proposed_increment: Hydrate matching schema/value revisions, errors and baseline as one unit, rejecting stale or incompatible envelopes and avoiding a false first-render transition.
priority_rationale: Supports server-rendered validation responses and consistent first-paint feedback.
observed_precedent: VeeValidate supports initial errors; Superforms returns validated form data from server actions.
source_titles: VeeValidate v4: handling forms; Superforms v2: file uploads
source_notes: Versioned v4 reference; not represented as the newest major.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Typed deep paths and composable lenses
current_support: Direct child access and immediate add/get/remove exist; reusable infrastructure must implement deep traversal.
proposed_increment: Provide typed path tuples and composable node lenses with safe optional/dynamic traversal and explicit unresolved results.
priority_rationale: Helps reusable subform components and backend adapters without replacing ergonomic direct node access.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form Lenses supplies composable typed field traversal.
source_notes: Official companion package; README/API evidence.

title: Native File and File[] bindings
current_support: Atomic fields can hold rich values; the native file input currently falls through to string value handling.
proposed_increment: Read selected files with typed single/multiple policy, clear the DOM correctly on reset, and model existing attachments separately from a browser selection.
priority_rationale: Fills a concrete native-control gap in common profile and attachment forms.
observed_precedent: FormKit and Superforms provide file input binding helpers.
source_titles: FormKit: file input; Superforms v2: file uploads
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Nested FormData serialization and decoding
current_support: Nodes expose JavaScript values; callers define transport encodings.
proposed_increment: Encode/decode nested objects, repeated arrays, nulls, booleans and files under a documented naming convention with validation of decoded input.
priority_rationale: Avoids incompatible multipart payload conventions across applications.
observed_precedent: Superforms handles file-aware requests and distinguishes nested JSON transport from ordinary FormData; our proposal would define its own explicit multipart convention.
source_titles: Superforms v2: file uploads; Superforms v2: nested data
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Documents nested transport and the distinction between JSON data and browser FormData.

title: Typed submission field projection
current_support: Hidden and disabled values remain in the model; consumers manually remove UI-only fields before sending.
proposed_increment: Select included paths or apply an explicit participation predicate at the submit boundary while preserving the complete editable model.
priority_rationale: Prevents accidental transport of confirmation fields, display state and irrelevant branches.
observed_precedent: VeeValidate exposes controlledValues and withControlled submission.
source_notes: Versioned v4 reference; not represented as the newest major.

title: Opt-in binding participation policy
current_support: Node lifetime is independent of DOM mounting; unbinding releases ownership but does not remove model data.
proposed_increment: Offer an explicit binding-managed policy for retain, exclude or unregister, including reference counting for multiple hosts.
priority_rationale: Makes conditional DOM-driven forms possible without changing the current safe default.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form exposes shouldUnregister; Modular Forms distinguishes active mounted fields.
source_titles: React Hook Form: useForm; Modular Forms: Field
source_notes: Official documentation source; live master, not a release pin.; Maintenance-mode predecessor of Formisch; used as a historical API precedent.

title: Named validation scopes independent of tree shape
current_support: Groups provide structural aggregation; one node belongs to one structural parent.
proposed_increment: Define reusable selections of nodes for validation and feedback without moving or duplicating them in the tree.
priority_rationale: Supports approval sections, tabs and cross-cutting checks over an existing DTO shape.
observed_precedent: Parsley has named validation groups; Vuelidate offers validation scopes.
source_notes: jQuery ecosystem; validation groups and priority policy.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Different revalidation policy after submission
current_support: Consumers can write conditional validators, but no shared validation phase policy ships.
proposed_increment: Select an initial trigger and a different trigger after the first attempted submit, with a reset operation that restores the initial phase.
priority_rationale: Allows quiet first entry followed by responsive correction after an error.
observed_precedent: TanStack revalidateLogic separates mode from modeAfterSubmission.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Rule priority and fail-fast execution
current_support: Multiple rules can contribute errors; no public general priority or bail policy is exposed.
proposed_increment: Offer stable priorities and explicit collect-all versus stop-on-failure execution, defining how async rules and cancellation interact.
priority_rationale: Avoids unnecessary expensive checks after a prerequisite has already failed.
observed_precedent: Parsley supports validation priorities; Ant Design exposes validateFirst.
source_notes: jQuery ecosystem; validation groups and priority policy.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Validation-only normalization
current_support: Applications can transform values inside custom validators; no reusable validation-input normalization helper ships.
proposed_increment: Compose a normalizer that changes only what validators inspect, leaving displayed and committed values unchanged.
priority_rationale: Useful for whitespace-insensitive checks when silently rewriting user input would be wrong.
observed_precedent: jQuery Validation provides a normalizer hook.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Remote validation result cache
current_support: Async cancellation, parameters and debounce exist; repeat requests are not backed by a public cache policy.
proposed_increment: Cache by rule identity and all relevant parameters with expiry, invalidation and explicit per-form or shared ownership.
priority_rationale: Reduces repeated network work when users revisit the same values.
observed_precedent: jQuery Validation reuses the prior result when serialized remote parameters match.
source_notes: Official source; step validation, deferred submission, and reuse of matching remote-validation results.

title: Validation probes without publishing new messages
current_support: Reading valid() is non-mutating, but there is no explicit run that returns fresh async results while withholding their presentation.
proposed_increment: Provide a validate-only execution mode returning results without touching fields or replacing visible message state; make result lifetime explicit.
priority_rationale: Useful for eligibility previews and action availability checks before requesting user correction.
observed_precedent: Ant Design exposes validateFields({ validateOnly: true }).
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Transactional subform editing
current_support: A nested form mutates its own live tree; a separate form can be constructed manually for a dialog.
proposed_increment: Fork an editable working copy with explicit apply/cancel and conflict detection if the source changes while the dialog is open.
priority_rationale: Makes modal address or row editors predictable without leaking half-completed edits into the parent.
observed_precedent: Ember Changeset stages changes before execute/save and supports rollback.
source_notes: Maintainer repository; staged changes, execution, rollback and snapshots.

title: Undo and redo history
current_support: reset returns to a declared baseline; no ordered user-edit history is maintained.
proposed_increment: Record bounded, coalesced checkpoints with transaction boundaries, redo invalidation and exclusions for sensitive or large values.
priority_rationale: Benefits long content and administrative forms where a single reset is too coarse.
observed_precedent: React Form Autosave documents optional undo/redo history; evidence is limited to its README.
source_notes: Small community helper. README evidence only; maintenance, reliability and adoption were not independently established.

title: Infer node constraints from external schemas
current_support: Built-in validators already supply required/min/max metadata; schema libraries are not connected.
proposed_increment: Add schema-specific introspection bridges for supported required/range/pattern constraints and document unsupported refinements.
priority_rationale: Keeps native attributes and visual requirements consistent with external domain schemas.
observed_precedent: Formly maps JSON Schema into field configuration. Standard Schema validation alone does not guarantee introspection.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Optional browser constraint-validation bridge
current_support: Native parsing and several constraint attributes are synchronized; no full public setCustomValidity/reportValidity policy ships.
proposed_increment: Bridge selected node errors to browser custom validity and define native versus custom presentation without introducing duplicate submission paths.
priority_rationale: Supports applications that want browser validation UI while retaining node-based rules.
observed_precedent: React Spectrum exposes native versus ARIA validation behavior.
source_notes: Versioned v3 component reference; native versus ARIA validation behavior.

title: Label, help and error association helpers
current_support: State attributes and custom control state exist; applications create label and message IDs and wire their relationships.
proposed_increment: Provide stable IDs and composable label/help/error bindings that preserve consumer aria-describedby entries and work across custom hosts.
priority_rationale: Improves accessibility consistency at every field without prescribing markup.
observed_precedent: Conform documents field IDs and accessible message associations.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Coordination across independent forms
current_support: Nested forms and closest-form discovery exist; independent roots have no named coordination registry.
proposed_increment: Register roots with scoped names and expose aggregate pending/changed state plus ordered multi-form actions without reparenting nodes.
priority_rationale: Supports split screens and separate dialogs whose changes are saved together.
observed_precedent: Ant Design Form.Provider links named forms and their events.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Managed calculated fields with override policy
current_support: computed values and onValueChange can implement calculations; callers manage writes, loops and user overrides.
proposed_increment: Package a derived-field binding with dependencies, lifecycle, optional manual override and explicit restoration of automatic calculation.
priority_rationale: Useful for totals, generated slugs and shipping defaults while preserving user intent.
observed_precedent: Final Form Calculate provides declarative field calculations; manual-override policy is our proposed addition.
source_notes: Companion decorator; declarative calculations.

title: Extensible typed node metadata
current_support: Constraint metadata exists internally and as fixed public signals; arbitrary public metadata keys are not exported.
proposed_increment: Expose typed keys and explicit reducer/inheritance rules for labels, descriptions and integration hints.
priority_rationale: Creates one shared extension surface for inspectors, schema bridges and renderers.
observed_precedent: Angular Signal Forms exposes metadata rules and reducers.
source_notes: Pinned public metadata mechanism; accompanying tests in test/node/api/metadata.spec.ts.

title: Managed node plugins with disposal
current_support: Factories, configuration and callbacks are extensible; consumers manually coordinate cross-cutting lifecycle cleanup.
proposed_increment: Provide plugin installation, inherited scope, deterministic disposal and opt-in hooks around supported lifecycle events.
priority_rationale: Lets optional helpers integrate consistently without adding every feature to node options.
observed_precedent: FormKit's architecture supports plugins and node hooks.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Pre-commit change interception
current_support: onValueChange observes committed changes; it is not a veto or pre-commit transform.
proposed_increment: Offer an explicit interception contract with source metadata, transform/reject outcomes and reentrancy rules for selected writes.
priority_rationale: Supports locked business transitions and centralized normalization that must happen before observers see a value.
observed_precedent: MobX Formkit, the successor of MobX React Form, exposes interceptors backed by MobX.
source_titles: MobX Formkit: interceptor implementation; MobX Formkit: project and migration
source_notes: Maintainer source for the successor of MobX React Form; live master, not a release pin.; Maintainer README records the rename and deprecation of the legacy mobx-react-form package.

title: Managed remote choices
current_support: Signals can feed option lists externally; the library does not own option loading state.
proposed_increment: Load options from reactive parameters with cancellation, stable value identity and loading/error/empty states separate from field validity.
priority_rationale: Removes repeated async select plumbing while keeping fetching outside the core node.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS can load choices from a REST service.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Cascading choice reconciliation
current_support: Cross-field callbacks can reset a dependent value; invalidation and races are left to each app.
proposed_increment: Coordinate parent-dependent option changes and explicitly retain, clear or flag selections that are no longer available.
priority_rationale: Prevents stale country/city or category/product combinations after upstream edits.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS supports choice URLs that reload when referenced answers change.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Construct nodes from JSON Schema
current_support: Factories build typed trees in code; no exported JSON Schema-to-node constructor exists.
proposed_increment: Build node structure, defaults and supported validators from a documented JSON Schema subset, with override hooks and diagnostics.
priority_rationale: Enables metadata-driven business forms while preserving manually authored forms as the primary API.
observed_precedent: Formly provides a JSON Schema mapping service.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Schema renderer and component registry
current_support: The library binds supplied controls; it does not render a form from metadata.
proposed_increment: Ship an optional renderer that resolves field kinds through a registry and binds existing Form Nodes to consumer-selected components.
priority_rationale: Allows generated forms without embedding a design system in the core package.
observed_precedent: JSON Forms publishes renderer sets for several frameworks.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Declarative form layout schema
current_support: Applications own templates and layout; no serializable layout vocabulary ships.
proposed_increment: Represent sections, groups, tabs and responsive layout separately from data paths, preserving state when layout changes.
priority_rationale: Lets a generated form match a usable screen rather than just listing every property.
observed_precedent: JSON Forms separates layouts from data schema.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Discriminated-union branch controller
current_support: Dynamic children and conditional state already exist; callers coordinate alternative shapes and their retained data.
proposed_increment: Manage named schema variants with typed narrowing, explicit branch retention and validation/submission participation.
priority_rationale: Fits payment methods and person/company forms without scattered branch cleanup.
observed_precedent: Formisch documents schema variants for conditional structures.
source_notes: Official successor documentation; explicitly records changed and removed semantics.

title: Per-row schema rendering rules
current_support: Array factories can create different nodes; component/layout selection for each row remains application code.
proposed_increment: Resolve renderer metadata per item value/index with stable identity and predictable updates when a discriminator changes.
priority_rationale: Supports heterogeneous order lines without rebuilding unaffected controls.
observed_precedent: react-jsonschema-form supports dynamic per-item UI schema functions.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Recursive schema references with lazy expansion
current_support: Applications can use factories for recursive structures; no schema-reference resolver is exported.
proposed_increment: Resolve reusable and recursive schema references lazily, distinguishing schema cycles from invalid cyclic data and limiting expansion.
priority_rationale: Enables tree editors while avoiding eager infinite node construction.
observed_precedent: react-jsonschema-form documents schema definitions and references.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Client/server form action protocol
current_support: onSubmit accepts arbitrary application handlers; error/result transport has no shared contract.
proposed_increment: Define request/result envelopes, server decoding and validation helpers, and client mapping against the submitted revision.
priority_rationale: Reduces duplication between server validation and client form feedback.
observed_precedent: Modular Forms historically integrated server actions; Formisch explicitly documents that this integration does not yet carry over.
source_titles: Formisch: migration from Modular Forms; Superforms v2: file uploads
source_notes: Official successor documentation; explicitly records changed and removed semantics.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Progressively enhanced native submission
current_support: Current bindings are designed around client node state; a guaranteed no-JavaScript form action flow is not packaged.
proposed_increment: Provide an optional native-name/action/encoding contract with client enhancement and equivalent server validation behavior.
priority_rationale: Valuable for public forms that must work before hydration or with unavailable client code.
observed_precedent: React Router Form enhances native submission; Modular Forms documented a native fallback.
source_titles: React Router: Form; Formisch: migration from Modular Forms
source_notes: Adjacent router integration, not a dedicated form state library.; Official successor documentation; explicitly records changed and removed semantics.

title: Upload progress and task lifecycle
current_support: Async submit handlers can upload files; progress and per-file tasks are application state.
proposed_increment: Provide a transport-neutral upload task interface for progress, cancellation, failures and mapping accepted files to server attachment IDs.
priority_rationale: Improves attachment-heavy forms without coupling the library to fetch or one storage vendor.
observed_precedent: Inertia exposes upload progress; Formwerk has basic upload handling.
source_titles: Inertia v2: forms; Formwerk: file fields
source_notes: Versioned v2 reference; newer documentation exists, so this is not a latest-version claim.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Configurable submission concurrency
current_support: Concurrent calls to submit are rejected.
proposed_increment: Add explicit prevent or replace-latest policies, optionally a serialized queue with immutable payload snapshots, while retaining prevent as default.
priority_rationale: Supports deliberate repeated saves without hidden parallel writes.
observed_precedent: Superforms documents prevent, allow and abort multiple-submit policies; a queue would be our extension.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Delayed submitting and timeout presentation
current_support: submitting is immediately observable; consumers implement delayed spinners and long-wait notices.
proposed_increment: Expose configurable delayed and long-running signals scoped to an attempt, clearing them on settlement or cancellation.
priority_rationale: Avoids flashing spinners while still explaining slow requests.
observed_precedent: Superforms exposes loading timers; a timeout indicator does not itself cancel a request.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Browser-history form restoration
current_support: Values can be saved manually; no route-entry-scoped restoration contract ships.
proposed_increment: Restore a checkpoint keyed to a specific history entry, including selected step and supported interaction state, with record/schema compatibility checks.
priority_rationale: Makes Back/Forward navigation preserve the right draft instead of one global latest copy.
observed_precedent: Superforms snapshots integrate with navigation; Inertia can remember keyed form state.
source_titles: Superforms v2: snapshots; Inertia v2: forms
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Versioned v2 reference; newer documentation exists, so this is not a latest-version claim.

title: Draft schema versioning and migration
current_support: No persistence layer or schema evolution contract exists.
proposed_increment: Version stored drafts and run explicit migration/discard logic before restoration, keeping an untouched backup until acceptance.
priority_rationale: Prevents deployments from breaking or misreading users' saved drafts.
observed_precedent: React Form Autosave documents schema versions and migrations; maturity remains unverified.
source_notes: Small community helper. README evidence only; maintenance, reliability and adoption were not independently established.

title: Cross-tab draft synchronization with conflicts
current_support: Each form instance is independent; cross-tab coordination is application code.
proposed_increment: Exchange draft revisions across tabs, suppress echo loops and surface concurrent edits instead of automatically overwriting changed fields.
priority_rationale: Useful for long-running administrative sessions opened in several tabs.
observed_precedent: React Form Autosave documents cross-tab synchronization; conflict handling here is our proposed extension.
source_notes: Small community helper. README evidence only; maintenance, reliability and adoption were not independently established.

title: Offline submission outbox
current_support: An offline request failure remains the application's responsibility.
proposed_increment: Persist explicit submissions, retry in a controlled order after reconnection, and expose queued/conflicted items with server idempotency integration.
priority_rationale: Useful for field-work applications, but adds substantial storage and backend coordination costs.
observed_precedent: Form.io's licensed offline module provides a persistent request queue.
source_notes: Licensed module; persistent request queue. Inspiration only, not a licensing or purchasing recommendation.

title: Changes since the last submission
current_support: submitted and dirty exist; neither compares current values with the payload of the last attempt.
proposed_increment: Track a separately named last-attempt snapshot and expose changed paths since that attempt, without confusing it with the last successful-save baseline.
priority_rationale: Supports retry messaging and deciding whether a displayed rejection still describes current input.
observed_precedent: Final Form exposes dirtySinceLastSubmit and per-field variants.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Active and visited field state
current_support: touched is available; focus() performs an action but there is no shared active-node or visited-field signal.
proposed_increment: Track the active bound control/node and first-visit state, including multiple bindings and custom control focus boundaries.
priority_rationale: Enables contextual help and analytics hooks without treating focus as an edit.
observed_precedent: Final Form exposes active and visited field information.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Virtualized-form reveal and focus adapter
current_support: Nodes survive unmounting and arrays preserve identity; offscreen controls cannot be focused until rendered.
proposed_increment: Provide a reveal contract that scrolls/materializes the target row, waits for its binding and then focuses it with cancellation.
priority_rationale: Completes error navigation for large tables without introducing DOM-dependent node lifetime.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form publishes virtualized-list integration examples; reveal coordination is our proposed packaged addition.
source_notes: Official recipes, including virtualization; not a built-in virtualization engine.

title: Logical validator combinators
current_support: Multiple validators compose conjunctively; arbitrary alternatives require a custom rule.
proposed_increment: Provide typed any/all/not composition with clear nested errors, async short-circuiting and cancellation semantics.
priority_rationale: Expresses alternate acceptable inputs without repeatedly rebuilding validator orchestration.
observed_precedent: Vuelidate provides or, and and not combinators.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Cross-field cardinality validators
current_support: requiredIf and custom group validators exist; no reusable at-least/exactly/at-most selection rule ships.
proposed_increment: Validate how many chosen sibling paths are filled or selected, with explicit empty-value rules and targeted feedback.
priority_rationale: Covers contact-method requirements and mutually exclusive choices with one reusable family.
observed_precedent: jQuery Validation includes require_from_group.
source_notes: Official validator source; minimum populated-field count in a configured group.

title: Numeric step and multiple-of validation
current_support: min/max/integer exist; no step or multiple-of validator and matching node constraint is exported.
proposed_increment: Add decimal-aware step validation with an explicit base and compatible native step synchronization.
priority_rationale: Covers prices, booking intervals and quantity increments without ad hoc floating-point checks.
observed_precedent: jQuery Validation implements step validation.
source_notes: Official source; step validation, deferred submission, and reuse of matching remote-validation results.

title: File acceptance validator family
current_support: Custom validators can inspect File values; reusable file policies are not exported.
proposed_increment: Validate individual and total size, count and accepted types with structured parameters and clear server-validation parity.
priority_rationale: Provides consistent attachment errors while keeping browser accept attributes as selection hints.
observed_precedent: Superforms demonstrates file-size schema validation; Formwerk supports file constraints.
source_titles: Superforms v2: file uploads; Formwerk: file fields
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Maintained locale message packs
current_support: Reactive localization, message catalogs and overrides already exist; consumers supply translations.
proposed_increment: Publish optional, individually importable translations for built-in error kinds with parameter-aware messages and fallback rules.
priority_rationale: Reduces setup for multilingual applications without changing the existing catalog API.
observed_precedent: FormKit ships locale message support.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Serializable conditional-rule interpreter
current_support: Reactive required/hidden/disabled conditions already work in TypeScript.
proposed_increment: Interpret a bounded declarative rule language over node paths, with registered operations and diagnostics rather than arbitrary script execution.
priority_rationale: Allows server-provided form policies without shipping executable application code in schemas.
observed_precedent: JSON Forms defines declarative SHOW/HIDE/ENABLE/DISABLE rules.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Schema and expression diagnostics
current_support: TypeScript checks authored APIs; runtime schemas and expressions have no dedicated diagnostic pass.
proposed_increment: Report unknown references, unsupported constructs, impossible conditions and rule cycles before rendering, with paths back to the definition.
priority_rationale: Makes metadata-driven forms debuggable instead of silently incomplete.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS documents expression validation and its newer linter integration.
source_titles: SurveyJS: conditional logic; SurveyJS: RESTful choices
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.; Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Validation execution trace and profiler
current_support: Tests can count validator runs; no consumer-facing causal timeline or duration view ships.
proposed_increment: Record opt-in rule start/stop/cancel events and triggering node revisions, with redacted data and a bounded development-only buffer.
priority_rationale: Explains repeated requests, cancellation storms and expensive cross-field dependencies.
observed_precedent: React Hook Form DevTools establishes inspector precedent; detailed causal profiling is an inferred extension, not a claimed RHF feature.
source_notes: Official companion tool; README/API evidence.

title: Reusable field presentation wrappers
current_support: CVA pass-through supports binding composition; it does not generate label/help/error shells.
proposed_increment: Allow composable renderer wrappers for field chrome, descriptions and feedback with one accessibility contract.
priority_rationale: Makes generated forms fit an application's design system without duplicating each control implementation.
observed_precedent: Formly supports custom field wrappers.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Named schema presentation presets
current_support: Factories share node defaults; generated UI configuration has no reusable preset layer.
proposed_increment: Define overridable bundles of renderer, wrapper, layout and metadata choices, with a documented merge order.
priority_rationale: Avoids repeated configuration for recurring concepts such as postal addresses and money fields.
observed_precedent: Formly's core configuration includes presets.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Schema-driven option labels
current_support: oneOf validates membership; value-to-label option rendering is supplied by applications.
proposed_increment: Map schema enums or const/title alternatives into typed option values and display labels with translation hooks.
priority_rationale: Keeps machine values stable while giving generated selects understandable labels.
observed_precedent: JSON Forms documents enum and oneOf label behavior.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: URL query parameter binding
current_support: Applications can manually patch nodes from router state; no canonical URL synchronization helper ships.
proposed_increment: Encode filter nodes into query parameters with defaults, repeated values and replace-versus-push policy; restore on navigation without loops.
priority_rationale: Makes search/filter forms shareable and compatible with browser history.
observed_precedent: React Router Form supports GET submissions that serialize to the URL.
source_notes: Adjacent router integration, not a dedicated form state library.

title: Locale-aware number and currency control adapter
current_support: Native numeric parsing is supported; locale-specific separators and formatting are custom control concerns.
proposed_increment: Provide an optional Intl-based adapter with explicit minor-unit scaling, caret behavior and incomplete-input handling.
priority_rationale: Useful for international business forms, although existing UI libraries may already supply an adequate component.
observed_precedent: Formwerk provides formatted and localized number fields.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Input masks with separate raw values
current_support: Consumers can bind mask-capable CVAs; no maintained mask adapter/policy ships.
proposed_increment: Integrate an external mask engine while preserving raw model values, partial input, caret position and parse feedback.
priority_rationale: Helps phone and identifier entry; best kept optional because masking behavior is complex.
observed_precedent: FormKit Pro provides a mask input.
source_notes: FormKit Pro component; commercial reference, not a dependency recommendation.

title: Segmented date and time control adapter
current_support: Native date/time parsing and CVA interoperability exist; no segmented locale-aware interaction layer ships.
proposed_increment: Offer an optional adapter contract for segmented controls with explicit calendar/date/time representation and incomplete-segment errors.
priority_rationale: Useful for design systems needing richer input than native controls; representation policy must precede implementation.
observed_precedent: Formwerk lists dedicated date and time field composables.
source_notes: Vue headless control catalog; high-level capability evidence, not a compatibility test.

title: Checkbox-group binding to one collection field
current_support: A native checkbox maps to a boolean; multiple-select maps to a collection, but checkbox collection toggling is not packaged.
proposed_increment: Bind several checkboxes to one typed collection with per-option identity, disabled-state and touched/dirty semantics.
priority_rationale: Covers permission and preference lists without creating one boolean node per option.
observed_precedent: Formwerk provides checkbox groups selecting multiple items.
source_notes: Vue headless control catalog; high-level capability evidence, not a compatibility test.

title: Headless searchable combobox integration
current_support: Existing CVAs and custom controls can bind; the library ships no combobox interaction helper.
proposed_increment: Provide an optional contract for query text, selected value, active option, keyboard selection and async choices as separate states.
priority_rationale: Useful for reusable design-system controls, but lower priority because mature component libraries already solve much of it.
observed_precedent: Formwerk provides combobox composables.
source_notes: Vue headless control catalog; high-level capability evidence, not a compatibility test.

title: One-time-password input adapter
current_support: An OTP component can use a CVA; no dedicated multi-cell binding contract ships.
proposed_increment: Coordinate cell focus, paste distribution, autofill and one committed code value, with one logical touch/error boundary.
priority_rationale: Removes repeated edge cases in authentication controls while remaining outside the core.
observed_precedent: Formwerk includes OTP field composables.
source_notes: Vue headless control catalog; high-level capability evidence, not a compatibility test.

title: File dropzone and preview lifecycle helper
current_support: Generic CVA integration can wrap a dropzone; no file preview ownership helper exists.
proposed_increment: Unify drop and picker selection, validate before preview, and manage object-URL creation/disposal as files are removed or rebound.
priority_rationale: Avoids memory leaks and inconsistent attachment interactions.
observed_precedent: Formwerk supports dropzones and automatic image/video previews.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Multi-thumb range control adapter
current_support: Native single-value range controls work; tuple-valued thumb interaction is supplied by custom components.
proposed_increment: Define a tuple-valued adapter with ordered bounds, per-thumb focus and one field-level interaction/error contract.
priority_rationale: Useful for price and availability ranges, with modest relevance to the state-library core.
observed_precedent: Formwerk describes sliders selecting one or more range values.
source_notes: Vue headless control catalog; high-level capability evidence, not a compatibility test.

title: Accessible repeatable-row editor helpers
current_support: Array add/remove/move/swap and a reorderable-array recipe already exist.
proposed_increment: Package row action bindings, focus after add/remove and keyboard/live-region announcements around existing array operations.
priority_rationale: Reduces repetitive accessible UI work without pretending array reordering is missing.
observed_precedent: FormKit's repeater provides row editing UI; our proposed emphasis is headless accessibility helpers.
source_notes: UI component reference; Form Nodes already provides array mutations.

title: Branching wizard navigation graph
current_support: A linear multi-step recipe exists; callers compute every branch and back-navigation decision.
proposed_increment: Extend a wizard with conditional edges, visited-route history and explicit handling when earlier answers invalidate the current route.
priority_rationale: Useful for onboarding and eligibility interviews, but excessive for most ordinary forms.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS documents conditional skip logic.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Completion and progress model
current_support: validity and interaction signals exist; an empty optional field can be valid without being answered.
proposed_increment: Define answered/completed states and weighted progress over participating fields or steps, with configurable empty-value semantics.
priority_rationale: Supports long-form progress indicators without conflating completion with validation success.
observed_precedent: FormKit exposes a completion state; aggregate weighted progress is our proposed extension.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Matrix and spreadsheet-style question adapter
current_support: Nested forms/arrays can represent cells; there is no matrix interaction or column-schema helper.
proposed_increment: Build an optional row/column renderer with cell validation navigation, column metadata and accessible keyboard traversal.
priority_rationale: Relevant to assessments and bulk administrative entry, but too specialized for default exports.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS provides matrix table questions.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Ranking question adapter
current_support: Arrays can reorder values; ranking options and selection constraints are application UI.
proposed_increment: Represent a ranked subset of named choices with keyboard reordering, labels and completion rules.
priority_rationale: Useful for surveys and preference collection; does not justify changing array semantics.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS provides ranking questions with selectable choice metadata.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Signature capture adapter
current_support: Rich atomic values and custom controls can hold a signature; no capture adapter is provided.
proposed_increment: Integrate a maintained signature canvas with explicit empty/reset/export behavior and resource cleanup.
priority_rationale: Useful in a narrow class of workflows; capturing an image alone makes no claim about signature assurance.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS includes a signature-pad question with image export formats.
source_notes: Official documentation; unversioned unless indicated.

title: Read-only review rendering
current_support: readonly state and direct value reads exist; applications author their own human-readable summaries.
proposed_increment: Render labeled values, option titles and grouped review sections without mounting disabled input widgets, with links back to editable fields.
priority_rationale: Provides a reusable confirmation screen; it should consume values without changing node interaction or validation state.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS demonstrates a consolidated read-only review mode.
source_notes: Official example; review layout and read-only presentation.

title: Printable and PDF form export
current_support: Consumers can serialize values but no document renderer ships.
proposed_increment: Offer a separate bridge from labels, layout and values to a print/PDF engine, documenting differences from interactive browser layout.
priority_rationale: Useful for records and sharing, but a substantial adjacent product with its own rendering costs.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS PDF Generator exports editable or read-only documents and is a separate commercial product.
source_notes: Separate commercial product; export capability only, no legal-signature claims relied on.

title: Quiz scoring separate from validation
current_support: Custom validators can identify wrong answers, but they would incorrectly make acceptable quiz responses invalid.
proposed_increment: Provide optional answer-key/scoring metadata and result aggregation independent of form validity and submission gates.
priority_rationale: Useful for assessments only; avoid encoding correctness as a blocking validation error.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS demonstrates weighted quiz scoring using answer metadata and application calculations.
source_notes: Official example; weighted scoring includes application code.

title: Visual form designer
current_support: Forms are authored in TypeScript and templates; no drag-and-drop schema editor exists.
proposed_increment: Build a separate designer with a constrained schema editor, preview and import/export, only after a renderer/schema contract stabilizes.
priority_rationale: Could serve non-developer teams, but would create a new product and should be demand-led.
observed_precedent: SurveyJS Survey Creator offers visual form authoring.
source_notes: Historical v2 product reference; visual builder, distinct from the headless state library.

title: Experimental WebMCP form integration
current_support: No public adapter exposes a form as an agent-callable browser tool.
proposed_increment: Explore an explicitly enabled integration using declared schemas, bounded field access and the existing submit pipeline; expose validation failures as structured results.
priority_rationale: Potentially useful later, but experimental browser/platform dependence makes it the lowest-priority item.
observed_precedent: Angular 22.1.6 contains experimental form WebMCP registration and tests.
source_notes: Experimental API despite its presence in a stable Angular release; accompanying tests in test/web/webmcp.spec.ts.
